camel_example: aliyun live ListLiveMessageGroupMessages --region cn-hangzhou --SortType 1 --AppId demo --PageSize 10 --GroupId grouptest
description_en: Queries the message list of a group by calling ListLiveMessageGroupMessages
description_zh: 调用ListLiveMessageGroupMessages查询群组消息列表
kebab_example: aliyun live list-live-message-group-messages --app-id demo --group-id grouptest --page-size 10 --sort-type 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListLiveMessageGroupMessages

parameters.help_en: The ID of the interactive message application to query
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的互动消息应用ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The group ID of the group to query
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The number of messages to display at a time. Valid values: [10,50]
parameters.help_zh: 一次显示的消息数量，取值范围[10,50]
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The sort type. Messages are sorted by the time they were sent. Valid values:

1: ascending order

2: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式，按消息发送时间先后进行排序。取值：

1：正序

2：逆序
parameters.name: sort_type

parameters.help_en: The start position of the query page. If this parameter is left empty, the first page is returned by default
parameters.help_zh: 查询页的起始位置，若为空则默认为首页
parameters.name: next_page_token

parameters.help_en: The message type to query. If this parameter is left empty, all message types are returned by default
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的消息类型，若为空则默认为全部类型
parameters.name: msg_type

parameters.help_en: The query start time, expressed as a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds. If this parameter is left empty, the earliest time is used by default
parameters.help_zh: 查询起始时间，用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。若为空则默认为最早时间
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The query end time, expressed as a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds. If this parameter is left empty, the latest time is used by default
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。若为空则默认为最晚时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The data center. This value must be consistent with the data center specified in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html. Currently supported data centers are Shanghai (cn-shanghai) and Singapore (ap-southeast-1)
parameters.help_zh: 数据中心，需要与https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html中的数据中心一致，当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）
parameters.name: data_center

GroupId.description_en: The group ID of the group to query

Hasmore.description_en: Indicates whether there is a next page

UserId.description_en: The ID of the user who sent the message

UserInfo.description_en: The extended information of the user who sent the message
UserInfo.description_zh: 消息发送用户的扩展信息

Timestamp.description_en: The time when the message was created, expressed as a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
Timestamp.description_zh: 消息创建时间。用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒

NextPageToken.description_en: The start position of the next page. The value is 0 if there is no next page
NextPageToken.description_zh: 下一页的起始位置，若没有下一页则为0
NextPageToken.title_en: 下一页的起始位置，若没有下一页则为0
NextPageToken.title_zh: 下一页的起始位置，若没有下一页则为0
